title: PiCar Mini 2WD: Open ESP32-C3 MicroPython Educational Robot (driver board v1.1)
description: Open low-cost 2WD educational robot: ESP32-C3 SuperMini + integrated driver board (TC1508A, power path, LEDs, buttons, ultrasonic header), MicroPython eight-chapter firmware, BOM, and documentation. Hardware under CERN-OHL-P-2.0; software under MIT.
